text:
The bowl is a large stainless steel mixing bowl, roughly 28 cm across at the rim. The tuna mound covers about 15 cm by 12 cm and is about 5 cm high, which gives roughly 350 ml. Flaked tuna is loose, so I used about 0.7 g/ml, which comes to roughly 200 g.

The vegetables are mostly hidden under and around the tuna. I estimate:
- red onion, about 15 g
- celery or green pepper, about 25 g
- red pepper or tomato, about 20 g

No mayonnaise or dressing is visible, so I did not add any.
